parts.name: SwitchRoot
parts.description: The switch: a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, which is also the track. Its children are rendered after it, as its siblings. Style it with `appearance: none`, `:checked`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible` and `:user-invalid`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is on. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control the switch. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over (`checked={setting}`); one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch is on at first, when it isn't controlled. Also its `checked` attribute: what a form reset puts back.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user turns the switch on or off, and once when a form reset changes an uncontrolled switch. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the switch is never held by it. A controlled switch shows `checked` until the owner writes the new state, or guesses it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch natively: it can't be focused or pressed, and `:disabled` matches it. A switch disabled while it has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) takes focus back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the switch focusable but cancels a press or Space, so it doesn't change. Sets `aria-readonly` and `data-readonly`. `readOnly={pending? setting}` locks it while a save is out without losing focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Sets the native `required` attribute: the switch must be on for its form, or its Field, to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the switch submits `value` under while it is on. Inside a FieldRoot, the field's `name` is used when this is absent.

props.name: value
props.description: What the switch submits with its form while on; the browser's default is `"on"`.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the switch's state differs from its initial one.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the switch is on.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the switch has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: SwitchThumb
parts.description: The moving part, always in the document. Place it in SwitchRoot, where it is the input's next sibling, and move it with `.Switch:checked + .Thumb`. It is `aria-hidden`.
